independent_ai_reviews.historical_reviews: The retry1 reports and their frozen manifest remain audit history only because they pinned an earlier Q1 candidate digest.
independent_ai_reviews.binding_model: The detached ledger pins this final Q1.json byte identity, fresh machine and human result hashes, and distinct independent reports one way. Q1.json does not contain the ledger digest or report digests, so the acceptance chain has no self-reference.
independent_ai_reviews.review_boundary: Independent reviews are implementation and policy-boundary review only; they are not mathematical proof, external literature verification, statistical validation, production evidence or public-release acceptance.
